episode_appearances.pitch: Convertible high heels that transform into flats with a removable stello heel support mechanism.
episode_appearances.offer: Kevin O'Leary offered $500,000 for 5% equity plus a $1.50 per pair royalty until $1 million is recouped; offer was declined.

timeline.event: Incorporated in Delaware as Pashion Footwear Inc.
Pitched on Shark Tank Season 12 Episode 14; declined Kevin O'Leary's royalty offer.
Filed Form C-AR annual report under CIK 0001970090 with SEC EDGAR.
Operates active online storefront at pashionfootwear.com selling convertible shoes and accessories.

claims.text: Pashion Footwear Inc. is an active, operating business selling convertible footwear online with SEC EDGAR C-AR filings through 2024 and an active commercial storefront.
Founder Haley Pavone declined Kevin O'Leary's $500,000 investment offer involving a $1.50 per pair royalty on Shark Tank, so no Shark investment closed.

episode_appearances.pitch: Honey-based gourmet sauces created by a teenage entrepreneur.
episode_appearances.offer: Kendra Scott offered $100,000 for 20% equity; accepted on air but deal did not close in due diligence.

timeline.event: Tyla-Simone Crayton and her mother founded Sienna Sauce in Texas.
Trademark application 90028169 filed for SIENNA SAUCE.
Pitched on Shark Tank S12E14; accepted Kendra Scott's on-air offer of $100,000 for 20%.
Post-show due diligence concluded without closing Kendra Scott's investment.
Operates online storefront at siennasauceco.com selling bottled sauces direct to consumer.

registry_records.entity_name: Tortoise Investments, L.L.C. / Sienna Sauce LLC

claims.text: Sienna Sauce operates as an active condiment company selling its bottled sauce products through its official storefront at siennasauceco.com.
Although Kendra Scott's $100,000-for-20% offer was accepted on television, the investment did not close during post-broadcast due diligence.
